title: Pipe chart scans job folder for PDF and photos
description:
View PDF / View Photos on the pipe chart now look under the job root — Reports, Misc, Docu, Images, and similar folders — instead of only a Videos/Reports package layout. Those folders are loaded automatically so buttons appear without browsing into them first.

Who is affected: PipeShare users reviewing inspections on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Pipe chart scans the job root (Reports / Misc / Docu / Images) for run-linked PDF and photos.
Media folders hydrate automatically so View PDF / View Photos can appear without opening those folders.
